item.summary: Norway's Minister of Justice and Public Security, Astri Aas-Hansen, told Aftenposten and NTB that the Binance theft shows that cybersecurity can in the most serious cases be a matter of public security, and pointed to the government's proposal to strengthen the Norwegian National Security Authority (NSM). Niklas Arvidsson, a professor at KTH Royal Institute of Technology, told SvD that crypto exchanges lack the safeguards of the banking system, such as deposit guarantees and financial supervision. Journalists at TV4 and Dagens Industri said the incident damages trust in the system as a whole.
